records.modelAssumption: Use the complete EU label carbohydrate as the available-CHO proxy. No added polyol is listed, but naturally occurring polyols and rounding are unmeasured. This is not a verified zero-polyol result; fibre is not subtracted again.
records.sensitivity: At fixed assigned GI, removing any part of this label-CHO proxy reduces its model contribution. No bound on real glycaemia is established.
